Class WrapperApp

Namespace
BOOSECoreApp.Core.Base
Assembly
BOOSECoreApp.dll

Adapts CanvasApp for use by BOOSE commands via IGraphicAdapter. Provides a unified interface for drawing operations, allowing commands to execute without directly referencing the canvas implementation.

RunProgram(string, IGraphicAdapter)

Parses and runs a BOOSE program on the specified IGraphicAdapter. Supports multi-line code and ignores empty lines or lines starting with '*'.

public static void RunProgram(string code, IGraphicAdapter grphicAdapter)

Parameters

code string

The BOOSE program code to execute.

grphicAdapter IGraphicAdapter

The graphic adapter used to execute commands on a canvas.

Remarks

Creates a CommandFactoryApp and StoredProgramApp, parses commands with ParserApp, then executes them. Exceptions are logged without terminating the host application.
